verdict.rationale: Lambda publishes a REST Cloud API with an OpenAPI spec for creating and managing cloud resources. The evidence shows it can launch instances, apply cloud-init, choose base images, and send support-ticket webhooks, and a community-built CLI/MCP server on top of it confirms instance find/launch/terminate is automatable. However, the docs describe firewall rules, usage viewing, and JupyterLab access through UI pages, with no evidence of API equivalents, so full UI parity is not demonstrated. Missing for 10: documented API coverage for firewalls, filesystems, 1-Click Clusters, and usage/billing, plus any explicit statement of UI–API parity.
